Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

October 24th 1912.

Sir,
The payment of repatriation funds was continued
on the 23rd inst 237 groups being dealt with.
The Office at which payment was made is now
closed but as there are still about 70 groups who have
not been paid owing to their previous refusal to
participate, a date will be fixed and advertised later
on which payment will be made. There appears to be
now no opposition to accepting the money.
On the 23rd inst two more of the minor rebel
leaders named Loo Vung Sai 羅鳳山 and Kwoh Tsau 郭超
absconded with money entrusted to them to pay to their
followers. The former took $200 and the latter $180.
Two rebels named Tien Taung 徐正 and Bang Yih
Woo 彭伯和 who had participated in the distribution of
repatriation funds on the 23rd inst to the extent of $20
and $16 respectively were arrested and taken to Louza
Station during the evening for creating a disturbance
in a brothel where they admitted they had gone to spend
their repatriation money.
At 1 p.m. on the 23rd inst a memorial service in
honour of the late Lieu Tih 劉鐵 who was one of the rebel
leaders in Hupeh was held in the Soochow Guild frenchtown.
He was shot at the Arsenal on June 19th 1914.
It is proposed to hold a memorial service in the
Sing Woo Dan 新舞旦 Theatre City on the 2nd of November
inst. in honour of Daung Chi Sung 唐繼聖 who was kidnapped
from Shanghai in March last and afterwards shot at Peking.
The 3rd Regiment of the 37th Brigade 500 strong
now quartered at the Hweichow Guild Ardenal Road will probably
be transferred by steam launch to Woosung forts to-day.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：Saturday 26 Oct 12.）

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

1912年10月24日。

先生：

遣返资金的发放工作于本月23日继续进行，共处理了237组人员。办理付款的办事处现已关闭，但由于仍有约70组人员因先前拒绝参与而尚未领款，日后将另行确定并公告付款日期。目前看来，已无人反对领取该笔款项。

本月23日，又有两名次要的反叛头目，名为羅鳳山（Loo Vung Sai）和郭超（Kwoh Tsau），携受托支付给其部下的款项潜逃。前者卷走200元，后者卷走180元。

两名反叛分子徐正（Tien Taung）和彭伯和（Bang Yih Woo）于本月23日分别领取了20元和16元的遣返费，当晚因在一家妓院闹事而被捕，并被带至老闸捕房。他们承认去那里是为了花掉领到的遣返费。

本月23日下午1时，在法租界苏州公所为纪念湖北反叛头目之一刘铁（Lieu Tih）举行了追悼会。他于1914年6月19日在兵工厂被枪杀。

拟于本月11月2日在市内新舞旦（Sing Woo Dan）戏院举行追悼会，以纪念唐繼聖（Daung Chi Sung）。唐氏于今年3月在上海被绑架，随后在北京被枪杀。

现驻阿尔登路徽州公所的第37旅第3团（兵力500人）今日可能会乘蒸汽驳船调往吴淞炮台。

您忠实的仆人，
（签名）
总探长。

警务处总监。

（左侧批注：1912年10月26日，星期六。）
